title: SIPPO — a bubble tea brand with a pixel smile
seo_title: SIPPO Bubble Tea Brand Identity | Muhammad Babar
description: Brand identity case study for SIPPO bubble tea: a pixel wordmark, a mascot with three moods, a lime and pink palette, and packaging, merch and a shopfront.
summary: A playful identity for a bubble tea brand: a pixel wordmark, a mascot with three moods and a loud lime and pink palette, carried from cup sleeves to the shopfront.
cover_alt: SIPPO bubble tea shopfront with a lime pixel wordmark and pink mascot on the window and a pink hanging sign

sections.label: The idea
sections.heading: Bubble tea that doesn’t take itself too seriously
sections.body:
SIPPO is a bubble tea brand made for a young, social crowd. The identity leans into fun: a chunky pixel wordmark that reads like a game title, a cheeky mascot, and two loud colours, acid lime and hot pink, set against black and a warm off-white.

The aim was a small system that is simple enough to print on a cup sleeve and strong enough to carry a whole shopfront.

sections.label: Mascot
sections.heading: One character, three moods
sections.body: The SIPPO mascot is a round pixel character drawn on the same grid as the wordmark. It comes in three poses: a wave hello, a wink, and a cool pose with sunglasses and a lime burst. Each one works on its own, so the mascot can sit on a cup, a T-shirt or a window without the logo next to it.

images.alt: The SIPPO pixel mascot in three poses: waving, winking, and wearing sunglasses with a lime starburst

sections.label: Packaging
sections.heading: Cups that look like SIPPO from across the room
sections.body: Cup sleeves alternate between lime and pink, so any table of drinks reads as SIPPO at a glance. The carrier puts the wordmark front and centre in pink, with the mascot printed on the lime cups below it.

images.alt: Two SIPPO bubble tea cups with pink and lime sleeves on a café table next to a croissant and sunglasses
A man in a black SIPPO T-shirt carrying a pink SIPPO cup carrier with two lime cups

sections.label: In the world
sections.heading: From T-shirts to the shop window
sections.body: The same few pieces, the wordmark, the mascot and the two colours, carry over to merch and signage: black and white T-shirts, a pink hanging sign, and a lime window graphic big enough to read from across the street.

images.alt: Two friends laughing at a café table in SIPPO T-shirts, one with the pink mascot, with lime and pink SIPPO cups
SIPPO shopfront with a lime pixel wordmark and waving pink mascot on the window
